NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 14, 11:36 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 21.4 DraftKings points for $8,100, against Arizona. Drake London (18.8, $7,000) and Chris Olave (17.7, $7,600) are next.

Drake London returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.68 projected points per $1,000 at $7,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 14, 11:36 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 6

Puka Nacua, LAR vs ARI ($8,100)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.4 DraftKings points at $8,100. That is 2.6 points clear of Drake London. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 27.4 routes. The salary works out to 2.64 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.5 points with a simulated floor of 9.7 and a ceiling of 41.8, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Drake London, ATL vs CHI ($7,000)

Drake London projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 24.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.68 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 38.1, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Chris Olave, NO at NYG ($7,600)

Chris Olave projects 3rd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $7,600. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 35.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.33 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 17.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 37.2, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against the Giants, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Germie Bernard, PIT at TB ($4,000)

Germie Bernard projects for 10.0 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 2.49 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 30 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 4.2 targets on 17.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Bernard averaged 10.0 points with a simulated floor of 2.9 and a ceiling of 21.4, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Pittsburgh is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 39.5.
